title: Waza: Static Preflight Boundary Honesty vs Preventive Runtime Enforcement
summary: Preflight inspection classifies `boundary` requirements and `.agent.md` tool allowlists (`requested-allowlist` / `requested-deny-all`) explicitly as `Unresolved`: static declarations and post-run graders observe recorded evidence after execution and never prove preventive runtime enforcement.
